name: Tick
description: Lightweight zero-dependency MCP time server with drift-guard checks.

tools.name: now
tools.description: Get the REAL current date and time. Call this at the start of a reply and before using any relative time words (yesterday, tomorrow, tonight, next week). Never guess time from context. NEVER write a clock time in your reply that did not come from this tool's output in THIS turn — a timestamp without a fresh call is a hallucination, even if it plausibly continues from an earlier one. ALWAYS pass the user's IANA timezone — this server is remote, so without it you get UTC, not the user's local time.

timezone.description: The user's IANA timezone, e.g. Europe/Warsaw. Omitting it returns UTC.

tools.name: since
tools.description: How long ago (or from now) a given ISO-8601 timestamp is, in human form ('3h 42m ago'). Use to check whether an event was really 'yesterday'. Include the UTC offset in the timestamp.
